hook.en: Midnight in the law archive. The student-body president has your ID - and his file is in your hands.
hook.zh: 午夜的法学院档案室，学生会主席捏着你的学生证——而你手里，正是他的档案。

options.en: Tell him the truth: someone is setting him up.
Snatch the file back and run for the stairs.
'Report me, then. I'll tell them what's in it.'
options.zh: “那你举报啊，我就说出里面写了什么”

caps.en: Archive closes at ten. You're on my camera at twelve-fifty.
caps.zh: 档案室十点就关门了。十二点五十，你出现在我的监控里。

caps.en: I was just returning a book.
caps.zh: 我只是来还一本书。

caps.en: You were returning my file.
caps.zh: 你是来还我的档案。

caps.en: I can report you to the board tonight... or you tell me who sent you.
caps.zh: 我今晚就可以把你报到理事会……或者，你告诉我是谁派你来的。

caps.en: You have until I put this back.
caps.zh: 在我把它放回去之前，给我答案。

hook.en: You benched the hockey captain in the final. Now he's blocking the tunnel - and asking for your number.
hook.zh: 决赛里你把冰球队长按上了替补席。现在他堵在通道里——找你要电话号码。

options.en: 'Follow my pen with your eyes, captain.'
Hand the clipboard back and walk past him.
options.zh: 把夹板还他，从他身边走过去

caps.en: You benched me in the third period.
caps.zh: 第三节你把我按在了替补席上。

caps.en: You failed the concussion check.
caps.zh: 你脑震荡检查没过。

caps.en: Ask me anything. Name, date... your number.
caps.zh: 随便问。名字、日期……你的电话号码。

caps.en: We won anyway. Team's at the bar. I'm not going.
caps.zh: 反正我们赢了。队友都去酒吧了。我不去。

caps.en: Unless my medic clears me... for one drink.
caps.zh: 除非我的队医批准我……喝一杯。

hook.en: You found the Moreau family's second ledger. Their heir found you.
hook.zh: 你翻到了莫罗家的第二本账，而他们的继承人找到了你。

options.en: "I work for whoever keeps me alive."
Take the glass — and keep the ledger.
Ask what happened to the last auditor.
options.zh: 问上一个审计师怎么了

caps.en: Most people who find that book leave through the back door.
caps.zh: 找到那本账的人，多半是从后门离开的。

caps.en: You're still here.
caps.zh: 你还在。

caps.en: My father wants you gone by morning. I told him I'd handle it.
caps.zh: 我父亲要你天亮前消失。我跟他说，我来处理。

caps.en: So. Do you work for him... or for me?
caps.zh: 所以，你是替他做事……还是替我？

hook.en: The lights die. Your new bodyguard covers your flashlight and counts the men coming for you.
hook.zh: 停电了。新来的保镖捂住你的手电，数着来抓你的人。

options.en: Take the card and start counting.

caps.en: Don't. They're watching the windows.
caps.zh: 别开手电。他们在盯着窗户。

caps.en: Two on the stairs. One in the lift.
caps.zh: 楼梯上两个，电梯里一个。

caps.en: Service door, end of the hall. Count to thirty, then run.
caps.zh: 走廊尽头，服务门。数到三十，就跑。

caps.en: If I'm not behind you by thirty... you don't come back for me.
caps.zh: 数到三十我还没跟上……你别回来找我。

hook.en: Your ex texted at 11:42. Your boyfriend of three years read every word.
hook.zh: 前任 11:42 发来消息，交往三年的男友一个字不落全看完了。

tags: Calm on the surface, serious underneath

options.en: Type: 'I'm happy. Don't text me again.'
options.zh: 回他：“我很好，别再联系我”

options.en: Block the number without a word.

caps.en: He still has you saved as 'home'.
caps.zh: 他手机里还把你存成“家”。

caps.en: I didn't answer him.
caps.zh: 我没回他。

caps.en: I know. I read the whole thread.
caps.zh: 我知道。整段聊天我都看完了。

caps.en: Three years. I've never once asked for your password.
caps.zh: 三年了。我一次都没问过你的密码。

caps.en: So answer him. Right now. While I watch.
caps.zh: 那就回他。现在。当着我的面。

hook.en: The CEO who bought your company stopped the elevator. You have ten minutes.
hook.zh: 收购你公司的 CEO 让电梯停了，你只有十分钟。

tags: Rival CEO who just acquired her firm
Cold, in control, cares more than he admits

options.en: Tear it up in front of him.

caps.en: Don't bother. I had maintenance stop it.
caps.zh: 别按了。是我让维修停的。

caps.en: You did what?
caps.zh: 你干了什么？

caps.en: Ten minutes. You've avoided me for six weeks.
caps.zh: 十分钟。你躲了我六个星期。

caps.en: Tomorrow you're my head of strategy... or you clean out your desk.
caps.zh: 明天起，你要么是我的战略总监……要么收拾桌子走人。

caps.en: I'd rather you hate me from the office next door.
caps.zh: 我宁可你在隔壁办公室恨我。
